source.title: On Memorization of Large Language Models in Logical Reasoning
source.authors: Chulin Xie; Yangsibo Huang; Chi-Yuan Zhang; Da Yu; Xinyun Chen; B. Lin; Bo Li; Badih Ghazi; Ravi Kumar

record.file_problem: None apparent; full paper text, including appendices, is present.
record.tranche_reason: It measures training and test accuracy during fine-tuning on a synthetic logical-reasoning task, bearing on delayed generalization, but uses pretrained LLMs and K&K puzzles rather than the original study’s setup.
record.gate_note: The paper tests fine-tuning dynamics on synthetic Knights and Knaves puzzles and reports train/test accuracy trajectories in Figure 4. Rows below cover the GPT4o-mini easy-task conditions for which the text says training accuracy nearly reaches interpolation and test accuracy increases over epochs. Cited grokking results and transferability results that do not report the delayed-generalization trajectory are not rows.
record.test_reason: The study does not test any version. It fine-tunes pretrained LLMs (GPT4o-mini for 5 epochs, Llama3-8B for up to 100) on synthetic Knights and Knaves puzzles. It tracks train and test accuracy, memorization scores and transfer, but never asks whether test accuracy jumps long after training accuracy saturates. GPT4o-mini's 5-epoch budget, with training accuracy measured on only 100 samples, leaves no post-saturation window. The paper only says it observes 'a related phenomenon', namely reasoning emerging alongside memorization. The systems are pretrained LLMs, not networks trained from scratch on small algorithmic data (V1). The data are synthetic, not realistic (V4).
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right. The authors conclude that fine-tuned LLMs memorize training puzzles (high LiMem on the train set, failing under local perturbations) while also gaining generalizable reasoning, which improves as memorization grows. They relate this to grokking only loosely, as 'a related phenomenon' in which reasoning emerges alongside memorization. They do not claim or test a delayed jump.
record.recipe_differences: The study fine-tunes pretrained Llama3-8B and GPT4o-mini on synthetic K&K puzzles, with or without synthetic reasoning steps. It does not reproduce the original small-network modular-arithmetic training setup.
record.method_sensitivity: Model capacity, puzzle difficulty, fine-tuning paradigm (Direct FT versus CoT FT), and training duration affect reported performance; the paper also reports different outcomes for different prompt formats and training-set sizes.

fits_no_version.finding: In fine-tuned LLMs on K&K puzzles, test accuracy and cross-difficulty transfer rise together with training-set memorization (LiMem). There is no reported delay; generalization improves across epochs alongside interpolation (Figs. 4–7).
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: During LLM fine-tuning on synthetic reasoning tasks, generalization emerges concurrently with memorization rather than after it.

record.problems: The relevant trajectories are presented in figures without exact values in the text. GPT4o-mini is fine-tuned for 5 epochs, while Llama3-8B uses longer training; the paper notes budget constraints. The tested task is synthetic K&K reasoning, so the result does not establish behavior on modular arithmetic or other grokking settings.
record.rows_left_out: Other figures report many model, puzzle-size, perturbation, and prompting conditions, plus transferability, probing, and memorization-score results. They were omitted because they do not add separate reported train/test accuracy trajectories for an interpolating training condition that bear on V1.

untested.parts: All of it: no small algorithmic dataset trained from scratch, no long post-saturation training, no chance-to-near-perfect jump, no train-set-size dependence of a delay.
No circuit formation or removal is traced. Probing shows true/false separability, not progress measures anticipating a jump.
No initialization-scale or weight-norm manipulation; no delayed generalization on image, text or molecule data.
No realistic pretraining or fine-tuning data; the K&K puzzles are synthetic, and no delay is measured.
No weight decay, critical dataset size or ungrokking.
No comparison of algorithms across runs.
No optimizer or numerical artifact controls.

record.verdict_notes: The reader's V1 'challenges' verdict is removed. Concurrent rise over a 5-epoch budget cannot challenge a claim about delayed jumps long after saturation in small algorithmic settings. The closest trajectory data are Llama3-8B's train and test accuracy over up to 100 epochs (Fig. 26). Those curves show no reported delayed jump, but the paper does not analyse them for one, so they are not recorded as a test either.

versions.untested_parts: It does not test modular arithmetic, chance-level test accuracy followed by a near-perfect jump, or whether the delay grows as training-set size shrinks.

No gradual formation or later removal of a specific generalizing circuit is tested; the probing experiments do not identify such a circuit or track a continuous progress measure anticipating a test-accuracy jump.
No image, text, or molecule training setting or initialization-scale/weight-norm manipulation is tested.
No realistic-data LLM pretraining or fine-tuning grokking trajectory is tested; the fine-tuning data are synthetic K&K puzzles.
Weight decay, low-norm circuit preference, critical dataset size, and ungrokking are not tested.
The paper does not compare identifiable algorithms learned across runs.
Adaptive-optimizer instability and floating-point/softmax artifact explanations are not evaluated.

rows.subject: GPT4o-mini
rows.operation_detail: Supervised fine-tuning on K&K question-answer pairs (Direct FT); test accuracy tracked across epochs.
rows.measure: Test accuracy over fine-tuning epochs; Figure 4 also plots training accuracy.
rows.note: The text says train and test accuracy increase over epochs and that GPT4o-mini nearly achieves interpolation on easy tasks using Direct FT. The reported trajectory is not a long period of saturated training accuracy with chance test accuracy followed by a delayed jump.
rows.check: 'Reversed' is wrong. Rising train and test accuracy over 5 epochs is not the opposite of delayed generalization. There is no post-interpolation phase, and GPT4o-mini's training accuracy comes from 100 samples. Values are figure-only (Fig. 4).
